possible_examples.question: When was the last time patient 22517 had the maximum value of arterial BP mean on or until 12/26/2105?
possible_examples.query: select chartevents.charttime from chartevents where chartevents.icustay_id in ( select icustays.icustay_id from icustays where icustays.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 22517 ) ) and chartevents.itemid in ( select d_items.itemid from d_items where d_items.label = 'arterial bp mean' and d_items.linksto = 'chartevents' ) and strftime('%y-%m-%d',chartevents.charttime) <= '2105-12-26' order by chartevents.valuenum desc, chartevents.charttime desc limit 1

possible_examples.question: What are the top four most frequent diagnoses that patients were diagnosed with within the same month after being diagnosed with sec mal neo brain/spine until 4 years ago?
possible_examples.query: select d_icd_diagnoses.short_title from d_icd_diagnoses where d_icd_diagnoses.icd9_code in ( select t3.icd9_code from ( select t2.icd9_code, dense_rank() over ( order by count(*) desc ) as c1 from ( select admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime from diagnoses_icd join admissions on diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id where diagnoses_icd.icd9_code = ( select d_icd_diagnoses.icd9_code from d_icd_diagnoses where d_icd_diagnoses.short_title = 'sec mal neo brain/spine' ) and datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) <= datetime(current_time,'-4 year') ) as t1 join ( select admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.icd9_code, diagnoses_icd.charttime from diagnoses_icd join admissions on diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id where datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) <= datetime(current_time,'-4 year') ) as t2 on t1.subject_id = t2.subject_id where t1.charttime < t2.charttime and datetime(t1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(t2.charttime,'start of month') group by t2.icd9_code ) as t3 where t3.c1 <= 4 )

possible_examples.question: tell me patient 1815's maximum arterial bp mean since 1185 days ago.
possible_examples.query: select max(chartevents.valuenum) from chartevents where chartevents.icustay_id in ( select icustays.icustay_id from icustays where icustays.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 1815 ) ) and chartevents.itemid in ( select d_items.itemid from d_items where d_items.label = 'arterial bp mean' and d_items.linksto = 'chartevents' ) and datetime(chartevents.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1185 day')

possible_examples.question: Retrieve the top four most frequent procedures since 2104.
possible_examples.query: select d_icd_procedures.short_title from d_icd_procedures where d_icd_procedures.icd9_code in ( select t1.icd9_code from ( select procedures_icd.icd9_code, dense_rank() over ( order by count(*) desc ) as c1 from procedures_icd where strftime('%y',procedures_icd.charttime) >= '2104' group by procedures_icd.icd9_code ) as t1 where t1.c1 <= 4 )

possible_examples.question: What was the drug that patient 20862 was prescribed for the first time via IV route since 13 months ago?
possible_examples.query: select prescriptions.drug from prescriptions where prescriptions.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 20862 ) and prescriptions.route = 'iv' and datetime(prescriptions.startdate) >= datetime(current_time,'-13 month') order by prescriptions.startdate asc limit 1

possible_examples.question: Has any medication been prescribed to patient 18237 this year?
possible_examples.query: select count(*)>0 from prescriptions where prescriptions.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 18237 ) and datetime(prescriptions.startdate,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year')

possible_examples.question: Show me the length of stay for patient 46802's last ICU stay.
possible_examples.query: select strftime('%j',icustays.outtime) - strftime('%j',icustays.intime) from icustays where icustays.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 46802 ) and icustays.outtime is not null order by icustays.intime desc limit 1

possible_examples.question: Calculate the total amount of D5NS that patient 13995 received until 07/30/2103.
possible_examples.query: select sum(inputevents_cv.amount) from inputevents_cv where inputevents_cv.icustay_id in ( select icustays.icustay_id from icustays where icustays.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 13995 ) ) and inputevents_cv.itemid in ( select d_items.itemid from d_items where d_items.label = 'd5ns' and d_items.linksto = 'inputevents_cv' ) and strftime('%y-%m-%d',inputevents_cv.charttime) <= '2103-07-30'

possible_examples.question: How many times is pantoprazole ordered for patient 42956 until 158 months ago?
possible_examples.query: select count(*) from prescriptions where prescriptions.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 42956 ) and prescriptions.drug = 'pantoprazole' and datetime(prescriptions.startdate) <= datetime(current_time,'-158 month')

possible_examples.question: What was the name of the output that patient 20000 first had on 02/24/2105?
possible_examples.query: select d_items.label from d_items where d_items.itemid in ( select outputevents.itemid from outputevents where outputevents.icustay_id in ( select icustays.icustay_id from icustays where icustays.hadm_id in ( select admissions.hadm_id from admissions where admissions.subject_id = 20000 ) ) and strftime('%y-%m-%d',outputevents.charttime) = '2105-02-24' order by outputevents.charttime asc limit 1 )
